title: Raising the residual floor past ≈4756 is the cheapest way to kill leftover L=84
statement: To exclude a Juggler cycle of length 84 it is necessary to raise the Lean residual floor past the global-finance exact-log threshold n ln n > 40269 (n ≈ 4756). Joint-minima and the odd-run height law do not kill L=84 before that floor.
counterexamples: Height law at floor 257/261 already excludes L=84 as a 1-cycle or 2-cycle (RHS 0.00091 and 0.00177 < θ=0.002086 at n=261, constant 1)
Joint-minima and height kill every m for L=84 at residual floor 1981 (constant 1) or 2325 (constant 6/5), strictly before global finance at 4756 / 5600
Killing every m is limited by m=31 (all valleys at n); the two bounds coincide there, so height does not beat joint on the full length, but both still beat a 4756 floor raise
A 4756 campaign is 2247 new odd certificates; n=2183 peaks at 19694 bits. The 1981 all-m campaign is still 859 odds with a 900-bit peak at n=1119
notes: Height already kills m=1,2 at the live Lean floor 261 without any raise. Formalizing that bound changes the Lean leftover to period 84 with m≥3, or ≥85. A residual-floor factory to 1981 or 4756 is machinery gravity. Not a halt theorem.
